limitations: Internal authoring, source, mathematical, snippet, conceptual, practitioner and pedagogical evidence only; no external ISO/POSIX/GNU, C/C++, shell/build/macro, browser/markup, database, security, migration, railway-signaling, safety, legal/regulatory, quality, accessibility/human-factors or independent validation review is claimed.
